## Pushed for review: change 2675

`https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2675` — "Make the Windows exclusive-leg tests
runnable". Two files: `tests/unit/store/test_windows_exclusive_leg.py` and the `sweep (windows)`
job in `.github/workflows/test.yml`. No production code.

Gates run locally before the push:

- `pytest tests/unit/store/test_windows_exclusive_leg.py -v` → 10 passed, 2 skipped (the two
  `test_native_*`, POSIX). Identical to before the change.
- The three AC5 concurrency suites → 39 passed.
- `make lint`, `make typecheck` → clean. The new sweep step is a `ci_gate` the mechanism-delta
  ratchet flags, so it carries a `# mechanism-ok: ci_gate …` justification at the definition
  site; `--check` now reports it as `admitted`, `new=0`.
- `make verify` (the full CI contract, 34 min) caught something `make lint` could not:
  `test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked`
  went red because the new step runs a repo-local file that a base predating this module cannot
  have. Legitimate — the step now carries the lane's standard if-present guard
  (`[ ! -f … ] → echo "…(change predates the gate) — skipping" → exit 0`), which is also what
  the parity module's empty-tree behaviour test requires. That test now passes.
- The re-run of `make verify` on the final tree is 19744 passed / 80 skipped / 1 failed, and the
  one failure is `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py::test_unrelated_
  remote_rejection_merges_and_rebuilds_private_candidate` — a `git clone -b tickets` exiting 128
  under xdist, which PASSES on its own on the same tree. Unrelated to this change (which cannot
  reach that code path) and not retried away: filed as bug `theocratic-actuarial-ibex`
  (`57d2-e356-7eb4-4bf5`) with the evidence and a root-cause-first acceptance criterion.

Sweep re-dispatched as run `33964509288` against the change's sha on
`feature/s1-windows-sweep-probe` (that prefix is in test.yml's `branches-ignore`, so pushing it
triggered no redundant CI, and its concurrency group is per-ref so no `main` run was cancelled —
there was no in-flight `main` run at dispatch time in any case). AC4 stays UNTICKED until that
job's log names both `test_native_*` as PASSED.
